stories.title: Stonewall hostage standoff ends in murder-suicide, Gillespie County sheriff says
stories.summary: Authorities found a 49-year-old victim and a 35-year-old suspect dead inside a Cemetery Road home after hours of efforts to resolve the situation peacefully.

stories.title: New 3,000-plus-acre state natural area opens in December near Boerne
stories.summary: The Albert and Bessie Kronkosky State Natural Area, often referred to as ABK SNA, is located off State Highway 46 between Boerne and Pipe Creek

stories.title: Officials: Former Bexar County deputy accused of shooting at constable officer during apartment eviction
stories.summary: The shooting happened just before 1:30 p.m. at an apartment complex in the 6600 block of Babcock Road, not far from De Zavala Road.

stories.title: United States Postal Inspection Service offers up to $100K reward for information in local post office mail theft
stories.summary: The United States Postal Inspection Service says the burglaries and mail theft happened three times in the past four weeks.

stories.title: Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa says she talked border with Trump, will roll back Abbott executive orders on H-1B visas, THC
stories.summary: In an interview with The Texas Tribune, the Austin Democrat discussed her first call with Trump, and the future of school vouchers.

stories.title: Have you seen Kendall? Bexar County deputies search for missing 16-year-old
stories.summary: Kendall Kay Garcia was last seen Monday morning on Yuba Trail and may be with a former boyfriend, according to the sheriff’s office.

stories.title: Woman killed by SWAT after allegedly shooting boyfriend in Seguin, police say
stories.summary: Police say Cynthia Hyatt, 60, pointed a weapon toward SWAT members during a standoff early Wednesday.

stories.title: A new ride for more second chances: San Antonio Feral Cat Coalition gets transport van
stories.summary: Foundation grants totaling $40,000 and a nonprofit discount from Ancira helped the volunteer-led organization secure a vehicle for its community cat programs.

stories.title: Thanksgiving assist: Spurs and H-E-B deliver 200 turkeys and a little extra cheer
stories.summary: San Antonio families received turkeys, groceries and Spurs tickets during a holiday giveaway at Our Lady of the Lake University.

stories.title: Gratitude takes root as Cibolo seniors share their Thanksgiving blessings
stories.summary: Residents at The Brooks of Cibolo created thankfulness trees and handwritten notes celebrating family, friends and neighbors.

stories.title: ZZ Top, Kaitlin Butts among new performers announced for 2027 San Antonio Rodeo
stories.summary: ZZ Top, Kaitlin Butts, Ryan Bingham & The Texas Gentlemen and Sara Evans make up the fourth round of entertainers announced for next year's rodeo.

stories.title: ‘There was no one there for those animals’: Judge sentences Kerrville man to four years
stories.summary: George Christopher Carrasco received a prison sentence in an animal cruelty case involving 10 dogs, some found dead and others severely malnourished.
